    What is Discord? Why should you jump on board?

    Discord is a social platform wherein you can create servers (private or public) through which you can build communities of customers. The servers can be either text, voice, or video through which you can invite people (privately through email/text or publicly through a link on your website or social media). Through these servers, you can directly communicate with your audience and keep them engaged.

    One of the main reasons you should jump on board is because of how seamless the network is and how much customer support the Discord administration provides. Being the Discord moderator, you can easily have full control over your server and assign roles to people. You can create an endless number of servers - you can internally communicate with your members and assign roles while simultaneously engaging your audience on another server. This is how seamless the interface is!

    Which features will work for you?

    Always remember that the audience on Discord is intellectual people with sound knowledge of modern marketing. The benefits of Discord community marketing are endless. Especially if you are a cryptocurrency-related agency. You can easily implement updated strategies, test new features, securely communicate real-time analytics with your audience, and offer exclusive sales.

    For example, it works to hold exclusive discounts and offers for your members. You can offer unique discounts to the first thousand members who join your server and provide the latest data to keep your audience updated. You can use threads while texting to keep your audience engaged and have insightful discussions on topics relevant to your niche. On the whole, consistent content and quality engagement will not only increase your audience base but also help retain them long-term.

    Which strategies work?

    On a monthly scale, Discord management has 20% more users as compared to other social media platforms. Fix your niche specifically and personalize your server accordingly - be it a book club, gaming community, dance class, or any other community of people. One of the best parts of this system is, the people who join your server through invites are already interested in your niche - that’s why they have joined in the first place!

    Some good strategies include live sessions, video chats wherein you can share your screen, have private discussions with members (you simply have to click on their name in the group server), and so on. Tap into fan clubs and other fan-made communities. This will greatly help if you don’t wish to create a community from scratch and build it from the start. Furthermore, the Discord management team is known for their unique partner programs - this will help you capitalize on the Discord community using the company itself!
